description: <attemptDir>/receipt.json. The physical result of the attempt, published once by the supervisor (or by adopt when the supervisor is gone). It is not the work result: the settle-attempt step judges the work.

fields.gateExit: the gate-exit.v1 object, or absent when no gate-exit.json exists

captureDigests.stdout: "sha256:<hex>" of the capture file bytes or null when absent

fields.outboxPresent: boolean, an outbox result-<N>.json exists in launch.outboxDir; equals `outboxResult != null`
fields.outboxResult: string or null, the file name of the newest outbox result (the agent protocol's rule: highest plain decimal N of result-<N>.json), null when there is none; the one newest-result rule, settlement reads this file
fields.reason: optional string; `start-refused:<code>` on abandoned-not-started when the supervisor named why it never bound (start-refused.json), e.g. lock-held on Windows; `terminal:<outcome>` or `terminal:blocked:<reason>` when a terminal adapter outcome (agent-protocol terminal-outcomes.v1.json) ended the run early, or when a soft-deadline or idle stop (outcome `timeout`) found the screen on a dead login, a used-up quota or a provider API error; `direct:blocked:<reason>` (login, usage-limit, provider-error) when a direct agent exited non-zero with no outbox result and the last lines of its stderr capture name the provider stop, or the last JSON event of its stdout capture is a provider API error. Settle turns a `blocked:login`, `blocked:usage-limit` or `blocked:provider-error` reason into a provider limit; any other reason never yields success
fields.providerSignal: optional object, present only with a `reason` of `direct|terminal:blocked:usage-limit|provider-error|login` and only when the agent protocol's extractor found at least one field in the same capture tails or screen that gave the reason; keys `status` (HTTP status 100-599), `statusWord` (`[A-Z_]{1,64}`), `requestedWaitMs` (integer, the wait the provider asked for), `resetHint` (the CLI's own reset phrase, at most 80 characters), each left out when not found; shape and bounds are the agent protocol's (agent-protocol.v1.json). The supervisor publishes what the protocol named and never classifies. Additive: `v` stays 1, a reader that does not know the field ignores it

outcomeRule: output-limit: gate-exit.stoppedBy == output-limit (the capture files passed launch.maxOutputBytes and the supervisor stopped the agent)
gate-lost: a binding exists but the gate died without gate-exit.json (the domain is empty because the lock is free)
carrier-lost: terminal mode; the terminal carrier died or was replaced (terminal-control inspect: pane gone or incarnation changed) while the gate had not published gate-exit.json
abandoned-not-started: no binding; adopt found the lock free

orphan with cause orphan-result maps to exited when an outbox result exists, else to gate-lost; orphan with cause abandoned-before-brief maps to abandoned-before-brief (terminal mode; nothing ran after GO)
outboxWins: an outbox result is settled whatever the outcome; the Run Result Evaluator still judges it
